text: Hi, our VAT ID has been on file since January but September's invoice for our 8 seats still charged the full 19%, and my bookkeeper Marta needs it corrected before she closes the books Friday. We're a 12-person shop in Leipzig and this is wrecking our reconciliation. Can you reissue the invoice with the VAT removed? NOT paying tax twice on the same software.

Your payment page keeps rejecting our card even though my bank shows the money leaving THREE separate times this morning, and now Lumen has suspended our subscription. My customers can't see the dashboards I promised them today and I look completely incompetent. Something is broken in how you process the charge — stop taking my money in triplicate and get us back online NOW.

I cancelled our plan on Aug 30 and your confirmation email literally said the $1,188 annual payment would be refunded within 10 days, but it's been three weeks and there's NOTHING in the bank. I run Brightside Pet Grooming and that money was earmarked for payroll this week. Where is my refund?? I've emailed twice and only gotten auto-replies back.

You've charged the company card ending 4412 for our monthly plan TWICE on the same day — $149 and then $149 again. I've got two receipts sitting in front of me and my finance guy is losing his mind. We're a tiny two-person studio (Halewood Design) and I can't just absorb a double hit. Please reverse the duplicate charge today.

Our plan auto-renewed last night at $2,400 when we signed up at $1,800 last year, and NOBODY warned me the price jumped 33%. I've got 15 staff depending on this and a $600 surprise is not okay for a shop our size. Revert it to the original price or cancel the renewal — I want this fixed today.

Not a fire, but our Salesforce connector stopped pulling in records for two of my reps, Priya and Tom, sometime yesterday — everyone else syncs perfectly. I'm guessing something changed with their access or role on our side? Not blocking anything critical right now, but I'd love to know why just those two vanished from my pipeline board.

Our BigQuery connector has been dead for 6 HOURS and every dashboard my clients pay me to maintain is stuck on stale numbers from this morning. I have a board review at 3pm and I'm going to look like an absolute fraud in front of my own customers. Is this an outage on your end?? I need the data flowing again immediately.

Since Sunday, not one of my scheduled Monday-7am reports has gone out to my 9 subscribers — I've checked everyone's spam and it's just silence. My wholesale buyers rely on that Monday stock email pulled from our Shopify data. Can you find out why the scheduler quietly stopped, because I've been sending the whole thing by hand?

The 'Revenue by Region' widget on our main dashboard is showing totals about 30% lower than what's actually in Postgres, and it now takes 40-plus seconds to even load. I re-ran the raw query myself and the real numbers are fine. My team has stopped trusting the board entirely — this started right after Tuesday's update, so what broke?

Whenever I click the 'Cohort Retention' chart it's greyed out and nothing happens — is this actually a bug, or did it get locked when we moved down a tier last month? I genuinely can't tell if it's broken or just not ours anymore. Not on fire, but my head of growth keeps asking for it and I have zero answers for her.

I'm completely locked out — my authenticator codes stopped working this morning and the backup codes you emailed never arrived. I have a report due to my biggest client, Delgado Foods, by noon and I cannot get into my workspace. Please help me back in fast, this is about to cost me the client.

I need to demote my marketing lead Chris from admin to viewer RIGHT NOW — he's leaving Friday and still has full access to all our customer data. Every time I change his role the save just spins and silently reverts. I can't have a departing employee with owner-level permissions over the weekend, so either fix the role controls or make the change for me today.

Hey, I'm trying to change the email on my profile from my old work address to my new one but the confirmation link you send just errors out with 'token expired.' It's not blocking anything today, but I don't want to lose access when the old inbox shuts down next month. Can you help me update it?

We've hit the 'seat limit reached' wall trying to add our 6th and 7th team members, and honestly I just need them in there this week. Is moving up to the pricier tier really the only way to squeeze more people into the workspace? Feels steep for two extra humans at Ridgeline Coffee, but tell me what the actual options are.

My business partner Dana created our workspace under her email and now that we're splitting the company, I need to become the owner and move her to a regular seat. I can't find any 'transfer ownership' button anywhere in the settings. Can you walk me through moving the workspace to dave@ before she loses access?

Quick one before I commit: if we go from 10 to 25 seats on the Team plan, what does the per-seat price drop to? I'm weighing Lumen against two competitors for my agency and the seat math is honestly the deciding factor. Just need the real numbers, no rush on this.

I need a formal quote — with our company details and a PO line — for 20 Team seats by this Friday, because our procurement guy Greg won't process a thing without a proper PDF. We're a growing logistics firm and I want to roll this out across the whole ops floor. Can you get me the paperwork before the deadline?

My biggest client won't renew next quarter unless we can prove SSO and a signed security addendum, and I'm told that requires the Enterprise tier — their deadline is in 48 hours. I have to move our contract up from Team to Enterprise and get the paperwork rolling TODAY or I lose a $40k-a-year customer. What is the fastest possible way to get this signed?

Can I book a live demo for me and my three department heads sometime next week? We've been on the Starter plan for six months and want to see exactly what Team unlocks before we expand from 5 to 30 people across Harbor Dental Group. Mornings are best for us — Tuesday or Wednesday would be ideal.

We're about to push way more traffic through the API and webhooks — realistically 2 million events a month instead of the 100k we do now — and I need to know what that costs on the top tier. My developers already built the whole integration, so I can't afford a surprise bill that eats my margins alive. Can someone send me the rate limits and the real pricing?

Honestly the new dashboard builder is the best I've used, whoever designed that drag-and-drop deserves a raise — SHOCKING that something around here finally just works. My whole crew at Copperline Electric picked it up without a single training call. No question, just didn't want the good stuff to go unnoticed for once.

I run a newsletter for 4,000 small retailers and I'd genuinely love to recommend Lumen to my readers, but I'd rather do it as a real partner than free marketing. Is there a referral or affiliate setup where I get a cut or a discount code to hand out? Point me at the right person and I'll start sending people your way.

I'm a reporter at a small-business publication writing about analytics tools for shops under 20 people, and I'd love a 20-minute chat with someone on your product side about how Lumen serves small teams. My editor wants to run the piece next month. Who's the right person to reach, and is a short quote doable?

We run an app marketplace for Shopify merchants and we'd like to feature Lumen as an analytics partner in our October roundup — but the submission form closes in 5 days and I need a partner contact plus logo files. My merchants keep asking me for a reporting tool and I want to point them straight at you. Can you get me the details this week?

I've spent 8 years building reporting tools and your product is exactly the kind of thing I'd love to work on — is the team hiring engineers or PMs right now? I couldn't find a careers page anywhere and had no idea where to send a CV. Happy to share my portfolio if there's an opening.
